fact: Ministry of Health and Data.FI authors say CMIS, developed as a custom system by the Ministry's HMIS Unit, was implemented in rural and urban health facilities with support from USAID, the World Bank and the Global Fund, the Global Fund procuring the hardware and other infrastructure; the poster reports data to FY23 Q3 and names no domestic funding.
title: Accelerating the achievement of health equity goals through a one record per citizen electronic medical record system in Eswatini
